_about: CMS field groups for brandvm.com, by field slug. Standard: Card · Page · <Section> · Relations & Filters · SEO & Sharing · Settings · Deprecated. Evidence: docs/audit/2026-10-20-cms-field-usage.md. Applied 2026-10-20 with data_cms_tool update_collection_field_groups (replaces the whole list).

post.description: Shown where posts are listed: /insights, Featured Articles, Recommended, nav, author and category pages. Thumbnail is also the OG image.
Post template: body and the Published / Updated dates in the header.
Featured ON = shown only in Featured Articles and hidden from the /insights list and nav. Category, author and related articles drive lists and the author box.
Not shown anywhere on the site (audit 2026-10-20). Display it or delete it.

author.description: Author page, and the author box on every post.

insights.description: Category template page settings: meta title, meta description, OG image.

badges-no-pages.description: Shown in the C | Badge Carousel component.

partners-no-pages.description: Shown in S | Logo Strip, S | Selected Clients, S | Contact and the Insights contact page.
No list sorts by this; every Partners list is curated or unsorted (audit 2026-10-20).

faqs.description: Shown in S | FAQs and on /faq.
Which pages show the FAQ: For Pages (static pages), Industry or one Service reference (that item's page), Category (/faq tabs). Sort Order sets the order.

case-studies.description: Shown in project grids: /our-work-portfolio, S | Projects, industry and service pages. Square thumbnail is also the OG image.
Highlights, challenges, approach, outcomes, each followed by its visuals. Use only bullet points and paragraphs here.
Sort Order (must be set to appear in S | Projects), completion date (list sort), and the service, industry and platform tags shown on the page.
Not shown anywhere (audit 2026-10-20). Four are empty; Byline - 3 copies the tagline; Deliverables is filled but not rendered.

services-no-pages.description: Shown on /services, the case study service tags and /our-work-portfolio filters.

platforms.description: Shown on /services, /web-design and /web-development, and as case study platform tags.

industry.description: Industry cards on /industries and the nav.
S | Service Hero. Hero image is also the OG image.
Services header and the service tabs (1–8). Tabs 7–8 are on the template but no industry fills them.
Advantage section: header, background and three cards.
Case studies shown on the industry page.
Where cards and links point. Only Real Estate differs from the default /industry/<slug>.

Work section header; projects come from Selected Works.
S | Why Choose counters: number, suffix, label.
